title: mri_stopmask
description: This program creates a mask used to stop the search for the maximum gradient in mris_place_surface, preventing the surface from wandering into areas it should not.

output_mask.description: Output stop mask in volume format
output_mask.title: Output Mask

filled.description: Include voxels edited fill voxels that are set in the filled.mgz
filled.title: Filled Volume Files

aseg_presurf.description: Used with --lv and/or --wmsa; Note: must be aseg.presurf.mgz, not aseg.mgz
aseg_presurf.title: ASEG presurf file

lateral_ventricles.description: Add lateral ventricles and choroid plexus to the mask (needs --aseg)
lateral_ventricles.title: Lateral Ventricles Flag

wmsa.description: Add WM hypointensities to the mask (needs --aseg); erode by given distance away from any adjacent cortex
wmsa.title: WMSA Erode mm
